tolerance_note: Every numeric quantity carries its own tolerance. Lengths and coordinates are in metres in the IFC project coordinate system (no georeferencing). Closed-form box volumes are exact to 1e-9 m3; the 1e-3 m3 tolerance on net wall volumes and space volumes allows for 32-bit float vertex positions in the viewer. Bounding boxes are exact to 1e-6 m.

computation.walls: Each wall is an IfcExtrudedAreaSolid of an IfcRectangleProfileDef, so its gross volume is dx x dy x dz. Net volume subtracts width x height x 0.30 m for every IfcOpeningElement that voids the wall; openings pass through the full wall thickness.
computation.slabs: Ground and intermediate slabs are 10 x 8 x 0.20 m boxes. The roof is the same box with an IfcBooleanClippingResult against an IfcHalfSpaceSolid whose plane runs from (9, z=6.40) to (10, z=6.20): the removed wedge is 0.5 x 1.00 x 0.20 x 8.00 = 0.80 m3, leaving 15.20 m3.
computation.mapped_items: One IfcRepresentationMap holds the 0.40 x 0.40 x 1.20 m box; five IfcMappedItem entities reference it from five IfcBuildingElementProxy elements. All instances use an identity mapping target, so each instance volume is the source box volume.
computation.spaces: Each IfcSpace is the 9.40 x 7.40 x 3.00 m clear volume inside the 0.30 m walls, one per storey.
computation.colours: Five IfcMaterial entities carry an IfcMaterialDefinitionRepresentation with an IfcSurfaceStyle; the same style is also assigned directly to each shape representation so that both material-based and item-based colour readers see it.
computation.counts: Counts of the entities authored below.
